approval: User approved Chattermill experiments on 2026-11-11; human labels requested when ready
deduplication: NFKC casefold whitespace normalized exact; token trigrams Jaccard>=0.9 with length ratio>=0.9 for texts>=8 tokens; union transitive groups before sampling
historical_reference: FABSA train and validation text only; official test is not opened
language: UK storefront is not a language guarantee; source candidates assessed automatically where available, then human language confirmation
labels: No rating-to-sentiment conversion or model-generated gold labels
privacy: Raw feeds private ignored output; exported reviews omit authors, usernames and profile links; redact email and phone-like identifiers
sampling: deterministic source-proportional random sample after duplicate removal, not outcome-based selection
public_outputs: code, configuration, tests and aggregate counts only
